figures.caption: Figure 1. Overview of the SHOVIR benchmark and evaluation protocol.

Table 1. Image-level evaluation on MIMIC-CXR and PadChest-GR. Baseline: performance on clean images. Full Noise Image (blue): performance when the entire image is replaced with noise. ∆FN (gray): absolute drop relative to baseline. Per metric, the best baseline is in bold; the highest and lowest ∆ are in bold and underlined, respectively.

Figure 2. Disease-level perturbation analysis on MIMIC-CXR (top row) and PadChest-GR (bottom row). Each curve reports the µ-F1 (weighted by class distribution) as a function of the perturbation ratio p for three experimental conditions: RO (left panel), OCO (center panel), and DOCO (right panel).
Figure 3. Per-pathology F1 breakdown (a) and per-model delta scores (b) on MIMIC-CXR and PadChest-GR.
